abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 6. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 106 | 250 |
